# Safety Violations Dashboard Configuration v1.0
# Grafana-style dashboard for safety monitoring and violation tracking

dashboard:
  version: "1.0"
  title: "Agentic Workflow - Safety Violations"
  description: "Safety system monitoring, violation tracking, and compliance metrics"
  
  # Dashboard metadata
  metadata:
    tags: ["agentic", "safety", "violations", "compliance"]
    refresh_interval: "30s"
    time_range: "last_24h"
    
  # Dashboard panels
  panels:
    # Safety Overview
    - title: "Safety Status"
      type: "stat"
      grid_pos: {"x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 8, "h": 8}
      targets:
        - expr: "safety_system_status"
          legend_format: "Status"
      field_config:
        defaults:
          mappings:
            - options:
                0: {text: "Critical", color: "red"}
                1: {text: "Warning", color: "yellow"}
                2: {text: "Healthy", color: "green"}
          
    - title: "Total Violations (24h)"
      type: "stat"
      grid_po
